device_analysis.description: Two waveguides that run parallel, curve toward each other in center for evanescent coupling, then curve back out
device_analysis.function: Evanescent power transfer between waveguides. Coupling ratio depends on gap and interaction length.
function_defining_knobs: coupling_gap_um - gap between waveguides at closest point (controls coupling strength)
coupling_length_um - length of parallel coupling region (controls coupling ratio)
port_separation_um - vertical distance between input/output ports
device_analysis.topology: Each arm: S-bend inward -> coupling straight -> S-bend outward

iterations.change_made: Initial guess: width=0.4, gap=0.15, coupling_len=4.0, port_sep=1.2
